title: A dual-signal-amplified electrochemical biosensor for sensitive and accurate detection of cancer cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32546-32552
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00364D, Paper
Open Access

Yujuan Wu, Yi Wang, Rongxiang He, Yu Li, Yali Ben
The crucial role of HRP in catalyzing the redox reaction between Fe(CN)63− and H2O2 is highlighted, with the resulting detectable current signals being linked to the quantity of captured target cancer cells.
